note: localAgents is regenerated in full from agents/*.md frontmatter every time `node scripts/sync-registries.mjs` runs — edit the agent files, not this section, to change an agent. discoveredAgentPackages is populated from live npm discovery (packages classified as agent-like: name/description mentions 'agent', 'swarm', or 'orchestrator') and is additive/upsert-only, so hand-added entries survive re-runs. A discovered agent package is metadata only — it is NOT wired into config/routing-table.json automatically; that step still requires a human or the coordinator to add a routing rule (see references/agent-catalog.md 'Adding a new agent').
